verdict.rationale: Mollie JS / Mollie Components embeds the cardholder-data fields in your own checkout in a way the docs call "fully PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliant," which is the scope-reduction outcome this story asks for. Mollie-hosted checkout pages are a second documented route for keeping card entry off merchant systems. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the tokenization flow (card data replaced by a token that never reaches the merchant server), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the SAQ-A scope claim.
